constraints: Bids only if confident in value
agents.name: Agent1

constraints: Limits bids to 150% of starting price
agents.goal: Achieve high returns through strategic bidding
agents.name: Agent2

constraints: Bids up to 200% of starting price
agents.goal: Acquire the art regardless of cost
agents.name: Agent3

causes.hypothesis: Higher risk tolerance leads to higher final bid price
causes.name: Bidder's Risk Tolerance

causes.hypothesis: A higher starting price increases the final bid price
causes.name: Starting Price

causes.hypothesis: More experience leads to more aggressive bidding
causes.name: Previous Auction Experience

interaction.stopping_rule: Auction ends when no further bids are placed

outcome.measurement_question: What is the final price paid for the art?
outcome.name: Final Bid Price
outcome.operationalization: The highest bid submitted by any agent at the end of the auction
outcome.respondent: Agent who submitted the winning bid

scenario: 3 bidders participating in an auction for a piece of art starting at fifty dollars
